implementedSlices.details: Added a shared accessible notice in the independent Driver app shell when an authenticated driver has no realtime connection. It warns that trip/request information may be stale and provides an explicit refresh action calling refreshDriver; action is disabled while the runtime is busy.

On the confirmed active booking screen, if a booking exists and realtime is disconnected, show a non-blocking accessible warning that ride status/driver location may be stale and an explicit Refresh booking status action calling fetchBooking; disable action while loading.

Customer mobile login and OTP verification now announce failure messages accessibly and expose explicit retry actions only after request exceptions. Retry repeats only the selected auth request; it does not retry booking or payment mutations. Server-declared invalid credentials/OTP responses do not expose network retry controls.

Customer profile-completion flow no longer treats a failed profile API fetch as a successful/complete profile. It keeps the user in the completion gate, exposes an accessible load-failure message, and offers an explicit retry action. Successful profile fetch clears the error; profile remains incomplete until required fields are saved.

Customer Home records location permission/GPS failures separately from the general message and displays an accessible recovery panel. User can retry current location or choose manual address entry; the recovery controls are disabled while a location request is active. Successful GPS acquisition clears the location error.

Customer launch now has an explicit session-restoring state, accessible failure message, retry restore action, and continue-to-sign-in recovery. When an authenticated saved session exists, backend active-trip lookup must succeed before restoring an active booking; a failed lookup no longer silently falls back to treating local booking metadata as authoritative. When the backend successfully reports no active trip, a locally stored booking is routed to Rides rather than restored as confirmed.
